title: Three-step whole-form chain carries an output into the next action
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. A complete passage is treated as a directed chain: one whole form selects an input, a second transforms it, and a third acts on the produced output. The claim is an occurrence-level participant transfer across three complete groups, not a component translation or adjacency count.

design.mechanism: directed whole-form transformers with explicit output-to-input binding
design.structural_basis: GDT608 retains directed formal composition plus pair-specific residual roles; GDT697 has one observed serial action-output bridge. This proposal asks whether that consequence recurs across independently bound complete passages.
design.passage_contract: Each candidate passage must contain three or more complete groups and an independently fixed source action chain with input, transformation, and later recipient/output. Every unknown group remains UNKNOWN until an external source meaning binds the role.
design.prediction: The participant named as the result of step two must be the participant consumed or modified by step three, with the same direction and role order across at least two source-bound passages. A nearest-neighbor or bag-of-wholes model may not substitute a different local participant.
design.smallest_test: Use the already admitted exact participant frames and one separately nominated complete source chain; freeze the three step positions and candidate role labels before checking any unbound occurrence. Compare output-linked chains with same-length shuffled and adjacency-only controls.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The apparent bridge is only local proximity: step three selects a neighboring noun or repeats a generic action without inheriting step two's output. A second failure is that each passage requires a different role mapping, preventing one shared consequence.
design.falsifier: No held chain preserves the step-two output as step-three input, or shuffled/adjacency controls match at the same rate, or a universal mapping requires retrospective exceptions.
design.source_binding: Required: a complete independently fixed practical sequence with explicit input, transformation result, and subsequent operation; GDT697 is a structural predecessor and cannot serve as the sole meaning source. No target-only gloss may establish the bridge.
prior_distinctions: GDT697 records seven bounded microrecords but only one serial bridge
GDT698 searches repeated exact participant frames
IDEA000068 proposes identity through transformation without a three-step output endpoint
design.access: Already admitted exposed sources only; no f84, f84r, f116v, reserves, new selectors, or new images. Mixed TSV access, if needed, must use selector-first query-tsv.
design.selection_status: raw_unreviewed; no independent meaning or blind confirmation claim
